args.body:
• Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, highlighting the scale of the returns challenge in retail logistics.
• Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%), showing the value of centralizing returns processing.
• Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin, making rapid resale turnaround a key lever for protecting profitability.
args.title: Bellwether 2026 Returns: Combined Summary
